34774-paper-cutting-machines-a-primer-of.title: Cutters, Power Cutters and Other Automatic Machines for Cutting Paper
34774-paper-cutting-machines-a-primer-of.creator: NIEL GRAY, Jr.
34774-paper-cutting-machines-a-primer-of.description: A book by NIEL GRAY, Jr.. It increases the possible printing output largely because presses of large size can now print many duplicates of a single design on a single sheet, and many of these sheets piled can be separated at a single cut, whereas a fly or rotating cutter cuts but one sheet at a time.

arxiv-1808-04883.title: CoLa : Decentralized Linear Learning
arxiv-1808-04883.creator: Lie He, An Bian, Martin Jaggi
arxiv-1808-04883.description: Abstract Decentralized machine learning is a promising emerging paradigm in view of global challenges of data ownership and privacy. We consider learning of linear classification and regression models, in the setting where the training data is decentralized over many user devices, and the learning algorithm must run on-device, on an arbitrary communication network, without a central coordinator.

arxiv-1909-08191.title: Exploring Scholarly Data by Semantic Query on Knowledge Graph Embedding Space
arxiv-1909-08191.creator: Hung Nghiep Tran, Atsuhiro Takasu
arxiv-1909-08191.description: Abstract The trends of open science have enabled several open scholarly datasets which include millions of papers and authors. Managing, exploring, and utilizing such large and complicated datasets effectively are challenging. In recent years, the knowledge graph has emerged as a universal data format for representing knowledge about heterogeneous entities and their relationships.

arxiv-2105-02093.title: Public Communication can Facilitate Low-Risk Coordination under Surveillance Conference: ; ; Thanks: Contact author: amos.korman@irif.fr
arxiv-2105-02093.creator: Amos Korman, Pierluigi Crescenzi
arxiv-2105-02093.description: Abstract . Abstract. Consider a sub-population of rebels that wish to initiate a revolution. In order to avoid initializing a failed revolution, rebels would first strive to estimate their relative "power", which is often correlated with their fraction in the population. However, and especially in non-democratic countries, rebels refrain from disclosing themselves.

arxiv-2106-00852.title: On the cogirth of binary matroids
arxiv-2106-00852.creator: Cameron Crenshaw, James Oxley
arxiv-2106-00852.description: Abstract . The cogirth, g ∗ ​ ( M ) g^{\ast}(M) , of a matroid M M is the size of a smallest cocircuit of M M . Finding the cogirth of a graphic matroid can be done in polynomial time, but Vardy showed in 1997 that it is NP-hard to find the cogirth of a binary matroid.

arxiv-2107-01887.title: An Analytical Survey on Recent Trends in High Dimensional Data Visualization
arxiv-2107-01887.creator: Alexander Kiefer, Md. Khaledur Rahman
arxiv-2107-01887.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alexander Kiefer, Md. Khaledur Rahman. Data visualization is the process by which data of any size or dimensionality is processed to produce an understandable set of data in a lower dimensionality, allowing it to be manipulated and understood more easily by people. The goal of our paper is to survey the performance of current high-dimensional data visualization techniques and quantify their strengths and weaknesses through relevant quantitative measures, including runtime, memory usage, clustering quality, separation quality, global structure preservation, and local structure preservation.

arxiv-2107-13699.title: Proton Shell Structure
arxiv-2107-13699.creator: Wei Kou, Chengdong Han, Xurong Chen
arxiv-2107-13699.description: Abstract We study the internal structure of the proton and propose a shell structure model of the proton. Based on the mass distribution and mass radius of proton we analyze the experiments at different energy scales and conclude that there should be shell structure inside proton, and the quark and gluon shells are energy-scale-dependent.

arxiv-2205-03141.title: Freezing in space-time: A functional equation linked with a PDE system Thanks: KB’s research was supported in part by Simons Foundation Grant 506732.
arxiv-2205-03141.creator: Krzysztof Burdzy and Adam J. Ostaszewski
arxiv-2205-03141.description: Abstract . We analyze the functional equation F ⁡ ( x + F ⁡ ( x ) ) = − F ⁡ ( x ) F(x+F(x))=-F(x) and reveal its relationship with a system of partial differential equations arising as the hydrodynamic limit of a system of pinned billiard balls on the line.

arxiv-2209-09617.title: Seq2Seq Surrogates of Epidemic Models to Facilitate Bayesian Inference
arxiv-2209-09617.creator: Giovanni Charles, Timothy M. Wolock, Peter Winskill, Azra Ghani, Samir Bhatt, Seth Flaxman
arxiv-2209-09617.description: Abstract Epidemic models are powerful tools in understanding infectious disease. However, as they increase in size and complexity, they can quickly become computationally intractable. Recent progress in modelling methodology has shown that surrogate models can be used to emulate complex epidemic models with a high-dimensional parameter space.

arxiv-2211-07436.description: Abstract The Better Scientific Software Fellowship (BSSwF) was launched in 2018 to foster and promote practices, processes, and tools to improve developer productivity and software sustainability of scientific codes. BSSwF’s vision is to grow the community with practitioners, leaders, mentors, and consultants to increase the visibility of scientific software production and sustainability.

arxiv-2310-11880.title: Online Convex Optimization with Switching Cost and Delayed Gradients
arxiv-2310-11880.creator: Spandan Senapati, Rahul Vaze
arxiv-2310-11880.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Spandan Senapati, Rahul Vaze. We consider the online convex optimization (OCO) problem with quadratic and linear switching cost in the limited information setting, where an online algorithm can choose its action using only gradient information about the previous objective function.

arxiv-2312-17620.title: Lower Bounds of Entanglement Quantifiers Based On Entanglement Witnesses
arxiv-2312-17620.creator: Xian Shi
arxiv-2312-17620.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xian Shi. To quantify the entanglement of bipartite systems in terms of some entanglement measure is a challenging problem in general, and it is much worse when the information about the system is less. In this manuscript, based on two classes of entanglement criteria, we present a method to obtain the lower bounds of the entanglement measures, concurrence, entanglement of formation, and geometrical entanglement measure.

arxiv-2502-04236.title: Saflo: eBPF-Based MPTCP Scheduler for Mitigating Traffic Analysis Attacks in Cellular Networks
arxiv-2502-04236.creator: Sangwoo Lee, Liuyi Jin, Radu Stoleru
arxiv-2502-04236.description: Abstract . This paper presents the saf ¯ \underline{\textbf{saf}} e sub flo ¯ \underline{\textbf{flo}} w (Saflo) eBPF-based multipath TCP (MPTCP) scheduler, designed to mitigate traffic analysis attacks in cellular networks. Traffic analysis attacks, which exploit vulnerabilities in Downlink Control Information (DCI) messages, remain a significant security threat in LTE/5G networks.

pmc-10653329.title: Exploring the dynamics of intentional sensorimotor desynchronization using phasing performance in music
pmc-10653329.creator: Ji Chul Kim
pmc-10653329.description: Humans tend to synchronize spontaneously to rhythmic stimuli or with other humans, but they can also desynchronize intentionally in certain situations. In this study, we investigate the dynamics of intentional sensorimotor desynchronization using phasing performance in music as an experimental paradigm.

pmc-11387432.title: Needs, preferences, and patient participation for a randomized controlled trial on postneoadjuvant complete tumor response: A qualitative study of patients with esophageal cancer
pmc-11387432.creator: Manuel Czornik, Joachim Weis, Andrea Kiemen, Claudia Schmoor, Julian Hipp, Jens Hoeppner
pmc-11387432.description: PurposeFor patients with clinical complete response of non-metastatic esophageal cancer (EC) after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) or neoadjuvant chemotherapy (nCT), the two treatment options obligate postneoadjuvant surgery as the current standard treatment (surgery on principle) versus active surveillance with surgery as needed only in recurring loco-regional tumor as a possible future alternative or standard exist.

pmc-11489732.title: Molecular mechanism of flower colour formation in Rhododendron simsii Planchon revealed by integration of microRNAome and RNAomics
pmc-11489732.creator: Jun Fu, Chuanchuan Tian, Xuchun Wan, Ruibin Hu, Jiaojun Yu, Jialiang Zhang, Shuzhen Wang, Colleen Doherty
pmc-11489732.description: Systems-wide understanding of gene expression profile regulating flower colour formation in Rhododendron simsii Planchon is insufficient. In this research, integration analysis of ribonucleic acid (RNA)omics and microRNAome were performed to reveal the molecular mechanism of flower colour formation in three R. simsii varieties with red, pink and crimson flowers, respectively.

pmc-11520778.title: Japanese encephalitis virus-induced DNA methylation contributes to blood-brain barrier permeability by modulating tight junction protein expression
pmc-11520778.creator: Xiao Xiang, Du Yu, Zhuangzhuang Li, Jelke J Fros, Jianchao Wei, Ke Liu, Zongjie Li, Donghua Shao, Beibei Li, Jeroen Kortekaas, Monique M van Oers, Zhiyong Ma, Gorben P Pijlman, Yafeng Qiu
pmc-11520778.description: Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) is a neurotropic and neuroinvasive flavivirus causing viral encephalitis, which seriously threatens the development of animal husbandry and human health. DNA methylation is a major epigenetic modification involved in viral pathogenesis, yet how DNA methylation affects JEV infection remains unknown.

pmc-12374657.title: Comparative analysis of iris blood flow after first-eye and second-eye cataract surgeries: insights into increased pain perception in the second eye
pmc-12374657.creator: Jitong Zhou, Yuxi Chen, Jiaqi Meng, Kaiwen Cheng, Jiao Qi, Yu Du, Yunqian Yao, Yi Lu, Wenwen He, Xiangjia Zhu
pmc-12374657.description: ObjectiveTo investigate quantitative changes in iris blood flow after first-eye and second-eye cataract surgeries, and their correlation with increased pain in the second eye.Methods and analysisIn this prospective study, 88 eyes of 44 participants who underwent uneventful cataract surgery were followed up at enrolment, 1 day before, and 1 day, 1 week and 1 month after each eye surgery.

pmc-13202034.title: Mapping the evidence on digital interventions to improve postpartum contraceptive uptake among adolescent mothers: a scoping review protocol
pmc-13202034.creator: Yuni Purwatiningsih, Esti Nugraheny, Suparmi, Bunga Astria Paramashanti, Siti Masitoh
pmc-13202034.description: AbstractIntroductionAdolescent mothers are at increased risk of rapid repeat pregnancy during the postpartum period, particularly in low-and middle-income countries where unmet need for contraception remains high. Stigma, limited autonomy and inadequate youth-friendly services contribute to low uptake of postpartum contraception. Digital health interventions have been proposed as scalable approaches to improve access to contraceptive information and support.

pmc-13223606.title: Motor imagery as a cognitive mechanism in interventions for children with developmental coordination disorder: a narrative review
pmc-13223606.creator: Yiheng Chi, Li Ke, Tanghai Cheng, Xinrui Ma
pmc-13223606.description: IntroductionDevelopmental Coordination Disorder (DCD) is a prevalent neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by significant motor impairments. Traditionally viewed as a deficit in motor execution, it is now increasingly understood to involve disruptions in cognitive processes underpinning motor control, including internal modeling, motor planning, and predictive control. This cognitive reconceptualization suggests the need for a shift in intervention approaches.

pmc-13356685.title: Multi-omics integration deciphers arsenic-induced multi-organ toxicity and the novel ferroptosis axis
pmc-13356685.creator: XingLai Zhang
pmc-13356685.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Chronic arsenic exposure threatens over 200 million people worldwide and induces multi-organ injury, yet the panoramic molecular reprogramming across organs remains incompletely understood, and traditional single-omics approaches fail to capture cross-level and cross-organ regulatory associations. This review systematically integrates evidence from global epidemiology to single-cell spatial omics, tracing the evolution of multi-omics technologies—from single-platform profiling to data fusion strategies such as coupled matrix factorization (CMF) and the DIABLO framework, two complementary multi-omics integration approaches—and to cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics.

pmc-13358531.title: Thoracic SMARCA4-deficient undifferentiated tumor: a systematic review and meta-analysis of individual patient data with cross-cohort survival comparison
pmc-13358531.creator: Zhuoying Su, Guiyang Chen, Fengmei Zhong, Bin Liu, Shuhong Wu, Fu Rong, Yanhua Lv, Xi Li
pmc-13358531.description: BackgroundThoracic SMARCA4-deficient undifferentiated tumor (SMARCA4-UT) is a rare, highly virulent neoplasm lacking a standardized therapeutic protocol. Because current evidence is scarce, systemic management guidelines are not well-defined. We aimed to address this lack of data by synthesizing individual patient-level data from case reports and retrospective series.

pmc-13365944.title: IFPHOR0051 Supporting Women with Recovery, Breastfeeding and Weight Management the Postnatal Period Through a Cocreated Nutrition Workshop
pmc-13365944.creator: Aliya Porter
pmc-13365944.description: There is currently a lack of nutrition advice in the UK for the postnatal period. Following informal discussions with over 20 pregnant women and new mums, and 5 professionals gaps in the information shared with women, the topics identified as most helpful to women were: nutrition for recovery, breastfeeding and weight management.

pmc-13428986.title: Spontaneous Splenic Rupture Associated With Cytomegalovirus Infection: A Case Report
pmc-13428986.creator: Kiara Sejfullai, Federica Giannini, Martina Sorrentino
pmc-13428986.description: Atraumatic splenic rupture is a rare but potentially life-threatening condition, most commonly associated with infectious, hematological, neoplastic, inflammatory, or iatrogenic disorders. Cytomegalovirus (CMV)-associated splenic rupture is an exceptionally uncommon complication in immunocompetent individuals. We report the case of a 46-year-old immunocompetent man who presented to the emergency department with acute abdominal pain and a low-grade fever.
